name: Jay Clayton
summary: Jay Clayton became director of national intelligence after the Senate confirmed him 51–47 on a party-line vote in late July 2026, succeeding Tulsi Gabbard, who resigned in June. A Wall Street lawyer, he chaired the Securities and Exchange Commission in Trump’s first term and was U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York from 2025. At his hearing he declined to say outright that Joe Biden won the 2020 election.
